word_translation_en: to lower; to reduce; to sink
sentence_example: Die Regierung will die Steuern senken.
sentence_example_translation_en: The government wants to lower taxes.
sentence_synonym: Die Regierung will die Steuern reduzieren.
typical_collocations: die Preise senken; die Steuern senken; die Kosten senken; den Blick senken; die Stimme senken
usage_comments_en: 'senken' is a transitive weak verb (senkte, hat gesenkt) meaning to make something go down. Contrast with the intransitive strong verb 'sinken' (sank, ist gesunken), which means to go down on its own. Common with abstract nouns (Kosten, Preise) and physical objects or body parts (den Kopf, den Blick).

word_translation_en: to lower; to sink; to reduce
sentence_example: Die Zentralbank will die Zinsen weiter absenken.
sentence_example_translation_en: The central bank wants to lower interest rates further.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Центральный банк хочет продолжить снижение процентных ставок.
sentence_synonym: Die Zentralbank will die Zinsen weiter senken.
typical_collocations: den Wasserspiegel absenken; Zinsen absenken; den Grenzwert absenken
usage_comments_en: Separable verb (senkt ab). Transitive or reflexive. Often used in technical, financial, or ecological contexts referring to physical levels (groundwater, ceilings) or institutional rates/limits. Distinct from 'herabsetzen', which often carries legal or evaluative weight.

word_translation_en: to lower down; to descend gently
sentence_example: Er senkte seinen Kopf traurig nieder.
sentence_synonym: Er senkte seinen Kopf traurig herab.
typical_collocations: den Blick niedersenken; das Haupt niedersenken; die Lider niedersenken
usage_comments_en: Highly literary/poetic and elevated register. Separable (senkt nieder). Most commonly found transitively with body parts denoting sadness or humility (den Blick, den Kopf) or reflexively (Dämmerung/Nebel senkt sich nieder).

word_translation_en: to sink; to submerge; to immerse
sentence_example: Das U-Boot versenkte das feindliche Schiff.
sentence_example_translation_en: The submarine sank the enemy ship.
sentence_synonym: Das U-Boot brachte das feindliche Schiff zum Untergehen.
typical_collocations: ein Schiff versenken; im Meer versenken; sich in Gedanken versenken
usage_comments_en: Inseparable weak verb (versenkt, versenkte, hat versenkt). Transitive: causes something to sink underwater or into a cavity. Reflexive with 'in + Akk.' (sich versenken) means to immerse oneself deeply in meditation, reading, or thought.
